title: reMending
description: Mending and Unbreaking now incompatible. Server-side.
body:
## Description

Prevents combining **Mending** and **Unbreaking** on the same item by making these enchantments mutually exclusive.

- Affects anvils, enchanting tables, and all vanilla mechanics that would normally allow stacking both enchantments.
- Ensures consistent behavior across all item types.
- Fully server-side — no client installation required.
- Lightweight implementation with zero dependencies.

A minimalistic tweak to enforce a deliberate trade-off:

> Infinite repair (**Mending**) _or_ extended durability (**Unbreaking**) — not both.
